semiconductor_relevance: High — Nissan Chemical Corporation is a key supplier of advanced materials for semiconductor lithography processes, including bottom anti-reflective coatings and EUV materials.
summary: Nissan Chemical Corporation specializes in the development and production of advanced materials for semiconductor lithography, such as bottom anti-reflective coatings compatible with various lithography technologies. The company is also advancing materials for extreme ultraviolet (EUV) lithography and exploring innovations in 3D packaging technology.
capabilities: Bottom anti-reflective coatings (BARC) for i-line, KrF, ArF, and Dual Damascene lithography
